contexts.text: Lying between the burdens = life among works... Burdens = works. The reason burdens are such works, is that they do not do good things from the affection of love towards the neighbour, but from the affection of love towards themselves; the works which flow from the affection of this love are like the burdens which the meaner kind of donkeys carry... AE 445:4.

The same thing is signified by burdens in the Book of Judges... Wherefore didst thou sit among the burdens, to hear the hissings of the flocks? ()... To hear the hissings of the flocks = disdain from those who are in the good of charity... To sit among the burdens = among meritorious works.
By burdens () are signified Knowledges and scientifics (in the natural man).
